description:
Cast Horned Kavu by paying {2}.
Horned Kavu enters the battlefield, triggering itself and Wild Pair.
Resolve the Horned Kavu trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Wild Pair trigger, searching your library for Thermopod and putting it onto the battlefield.
Activate Thermopod's second ability by sacrificing itself, adding {R}.
Thermopod dies, triggering Sek'Kuar and The Cauldron of Eternity.
Resolve the Sek'Kuar trigger, creating a 3/1 Graveborn creature token.
Resolve the Cauldron of Eternity trigger, putting Thermopod on the bottom of your library from your graveyard.
Repeat steps 1 through 4 one additional time.
Activate Thermopod's second ability by sacrificing the Graveborn, adding {R}.
Repeat from step 5.
